node.statement: Setup: choose an index s with w_s = w_*; set B := {i : w_i = w_*}, q := sum_{i in B} p_i, r := sum_{i in A} p_i, D := sum_{i in A} p_i n(w_i), and N := sum_{i in A} p_i n(w_i - w_*). Then q > 0, A is the complement of B, r = 1 - q, every difference w_i - w_j has coordinate sum zero, and the root inequality is N <= (2 + sqrt(2))*D.
